answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 6 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in signal, verified in pulse, and lantern names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 1 hours of verification and 6 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
